title: pre-launch hook payload (stdin)
description: Hook outcome: exit 0 continues; exit 13 escalates (remaining hooks still run; the launch exits 13, phase launch); any other non-zero exit vetoes at once (exit 11); a timeout is a veto with end_reason hook_timeout. Stderr (control characters stripped, capped at 2 KiB) becomes the outcome message. Stdout: if a JSON object, its decision_id (string or list of strings) is recorded in the run's decision_ids, the launch log event and any launch_escalation_override audit record; other keys and non-JSON stdout are ignored (logged).

repo.description: Repo id host/<full project path> (no . or .. segments).

ts.description: When this payload was delivered (delivery is at least once; see event_ts for post-state-change).

pending.description: true when the run was created by start (or start --resume) and is being adopted.

previous_run_kind.description: Kind of the previous run (resume) or of the source's last run (fork); null for a new session.

sandbox.description: Intended sandbox mode; whether it actually ran is reported later as sandbox_active (post-state-change, status).

permission_profile.description: Profile name from config, or file:<sha256 prefix> for a profile file (snapshotted at launch).

env_names.description: Names (never values) of the variables the session will get.

has_prompt.description: Whether a prompt file is delivered. The prompt text is never in the payload.

override_escalation.description: true on a resume (or start --resume) given --override-escalation after a run that ended escalated; exactly the hook entries recorded as escalating on that run are overridden (their exit 13 counts as continue); other hooks still escalate, vetoes still veto.

actor.description: Effective actor: --actor, else human:<me.name> when stdin is a TTY, else auto:unknown (honor system, not authentication).
